title: MacSteam Compatibility Report
description: Schema for per-game runtime compatibility status reports

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier; must be 1 for this schema revision

runtimeId.description: Identifier of the runtime used for compatibility testing

gameId.description: Identifier of the game being tested

status.description: Current compatibility status of the game with the specified runtime

detectedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this compatibility status was determined

detectionMethod.description: Method used to detect the game and assess compatibility

errors.description: Error messages associated with this compatibility report

warnings.description: Warning messages associated with this compatibility report
